data.root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion on rds-postgres-orders-prod triggered by a sudden surge in unindexed SELECT queries from checkout microservice deployment v2.4.1. CPU reached 99.4% and freeable memory dropped to 12MB.
recommendations: Roll back checkout-service deployment v2.4.1 to v2.4.0 or deploy hotfix adding index on orders(created_at, status).
Temporarily increase RDS max_connections parameter from 200 to 400 to relieve lock contention.
Enable Amazon RDS Proxy between ECS tasks and PostgreSQL database to enforce connection pooling.
